posts.text: I don’t want to be an alarmist, but a commander in chief who wants to blame foreign cyber attacks against American assets on domestic partisans so as to avoid admitting he made a mess of things, is … suboptimal.
posts.summary: Criticizes commander in chief blaming domestic partisans for cyber attacks to avoid accountability
